title: AWKUM Lecturer in Computer Science Jobs 2026 – Online Applications Open for Qualified ETEA Candidates
text:
Lecturer in Computer Science (Fixed Pay)

With reference to
Advertisement No. 67 (2026)
and the

ETEA written test conducted on August 8, 2026
,
all candidates who have qualified the test are requested to submit
their online application through the University's job portal.

Online Application Portal

Qualified candidates are required to complete their application
through the University's official job portal.

Application Deadline:

August 27, 2026

Candidates are requested to complete and submit the application form
by
August 27, 2026
and strictly follow the
instructions communicated through email.

Apply Online (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk)

jobs.awkum.edu.pk

Important:

Candidates should ensure that their application is submitted before
the deadline and that all instructions communicated through email
are followed carefully.
